import { Navbar, Nav, NavItem, NavLink } from "reactstrap";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

const Header = () => {
  return (
    <Navbar color="light" light expand="md" className="px-4">
      <Nav className="me-auto" navbar>
        <NavItem>
          <NavLink tag={Link} to="/">
            Home
          </NavLink>
        </NavItem>
        <NavItem>
          <NavLink tag={Link} to="/findjob">
            Find Job
          </NavLink>
        </NavItem>
        <NavItem>
          <NavLink tag={Link} to="/postjob">
            Post Job
          </NavLink>
        </NavItem>
        <NavItem>
          <NavLink tag={Link} to="/studentlogin">
            Student Login
          </NavLink>
        </NavItem>
        <NavItem>
          <NavLink tag={Link} to="/companylogin">
            Company Login
          </NavLink>
        </NavItem>
        <NavItem>
          <NavLink tag={Link} to="/about">
            About
          </NavLink>
        </NavItem>
      </Nav>
    </Navbar>
  );
};

export default Header;
